title: She Beat Up Her Boyfriend Then Spit On Police
description:
Here’s what happens when you spit on not one but two cops. The woman wasn’t stopping with her abuses, and it was clear the officers were oblivious to what she was about to do. And comes the suspect’s choice-awarded lines of the decade. The medics had arrived, but they had no medicine that could fix her attitude. The woman was charged with simple battery, battery upon a peace officer, destruction of property and resisting arrest.
